Name mDOT Telescope-CubeSat (Miniaturized Distributed Occulter/Telescope)
Type CubeSat
Units or mass 6U
Status cancelled
Entity name Stanford University

Entity type Academic / Education

Partners Tyvak, NASA
Oneliner

Telescope-cubesat carries a 10cm-diameter telescope.
Description

Potential to demonstrate the distributed occulter/telescope technology with scientific return using a CubeSat. UV telescope with 10 cm aperture. Ejected from occulter spacecraft and assumes formation. The satellites are launched combined as a secondary payload for a total mission lifetime of 1.1 years. After launch, the occulter-smallsat ejects the telescope-cubesat and maneuvers to establish the desired relative orbit, leaving the spacecraft at slightly different longitudes of ascending node.
